report.manualDesc: Use this when you have a user or message ID but cannot open those menus — for example, content shared outside Echo.
report.intro: Reports go to Echo's Trust & Safety team for review. Most reports are handled within a few business days.
report.fromProfile: From a user profile — open their profile menu and choose {report}
report.fromMessage: From a message — right-click or long-press and choose {report}

permPreview.title: Permission preview
permPreview.desc: Effective permissions for your account (server fold, then category and channel layers). Requires manage roles or manage server.
permPreview.signIn: Sign in with Echo (non-mock) to load this panel.

join.descVoice: You’ll join the server and connect to voice when you confirm.
join.descServer: You’ll become a member and can see channels based on your roles.

discordImport.title: Import recent Discord messages
discordImport.loginRequired: You must be logged in to import messages.
discordImport.descInto: This channel came from Discord. You can copy the last 90 messages into {channel}.
discordImport.descHere: This channel came from Discord. You can copy the last 90 messages here to preserve recent history.
discordImport.note: Authors without a linked Discord account show as placeholder profiles.
